newsitem.title: CANADA: Provigo in talks on its C Corp unit.
newsitem.headline: Provigo in talks on its C Corp unit.

text.p: Provigo Inc said on Friday that certain groups have show an interest in its C Corp Inc subsidiary.

No agreement has yet been submitted to Provigo's board of directors for approval, but the company intends to pursue discussions with the interested parties to cover all options which may enhance C Corp's development, the company said.
Provigo did not name the interested parties.

C Corp is based in St. Laurent, Quebec, generates about C$300 million of annual sales, and operates 245 Provi-Soir convenience stores in Quebec, 41 Winks stores in Ontario and eight Red Rooster outlets in Alberta.
The majority of sites are operated by franchisees, Provigo said.
